data.title: BlackRock's Robert Mitchnick on bitcoin's comeback and what's next for institutional adoption
data.description: Robbie Mitchnick, BlackRock’s head of digital assets, joins CNBC's Tanaya Macheel for an exclusive interview about what’s driving crypto's rebound, whether bitcoin’s role as a portfolio diversifier is changing, and whether growing concerns over U.S. debt and currency debasement strengthen the long-term case for the asset.
